title: Northgate Memberships Refund Terms Schedule
content:
The refund terms of Northgate Memberships vary by tier in four respects: the full-refund window, whether a refund is still given after that window, whether the refund is reduced by the Annual Reward of the current membership year, and whether add-on card fees are covered.

| Tier | Full-refund window (calendar days from the first day of the membership year) | Refund for unused whole months after the window | Refund reduced by the current year's Annual Reward | Refund also covers current-year add-on card fees |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| Northgate Student Club Membership | 30 days | No | No | No |
| Northgate Heroes Club Membership | 90 days | Yes | No | No |
| Northgate Club Membership | 90 days | Yes | No | No |
| Northgate Business Membership | 60 days | Yes | No | Yes |
| Northgate Club Plus Membership | 90 days | Yes | Yes | No |
| Northgate Business Plus Membership | 60 days | Yes | Yes | Yes |

## Definitions used in the schedule

- **Full-refund window.** The number of calendar days from the first day of the current membership year during which a cancellation refunds the current-year fees in full.
- **Refund after the window.** Whether a cancellation after the full-refund window refunds the current-year fees for the unused whole months. The Student Club tier reads No.
- **Reduced by Annual Reward.** Whether a cancellation refund is reduced by the Annual Reward accrued in the current membership year; only the two Plus tiers read Yes.
- **Add-on card fees.** Whether a cancellation refund also covers add-on card fees paid for the current membership year on the same basis; only the two business tiers read Yes.

## Comparisons drawn from the schedule

- The longest full-refund window is 90 days (Heroes Club, Club, Club Plus); the business tiers have 60 days; the Student Club tier 30 days.
- A tier that reads Yes in both of the last two columns is Northgate Business Plus Membership alone.
